name: Setup System Settings
script:
try:
    ss = frappe.get_doc("System Settings")
    ss.enable_onboarding = 0
    ss.deny_multiple_sessions = 1
    ss.number_format = "#,###.##"
    ss.float_precision = 2
    ss.currency_precision = 2
    ss.first_day_of_the_week = "Monday"
    ss.apply_strict_user_permissions = 1
    ss.allow_login_using_user_name = 1
    ss.disable_system_update_notification = 1
    ss.disable_change_log_notification = 1
    ss.show_full_error = 1
    ss.allow_error_report = 1
    ss.allow_usage_data = 1
    ss.log_api_requests = 1

    ss.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.log_error("System Settings updated successfully", "Setup Script Success")
except Exception:
    frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), "System Settings Update Failed")

name: Delete Learning Shortcut
Website Settings Setup
script:
try:
    ws = frappe.get_doc("Website Settings")
    ws.app_name = "Hicom System"
    ws.footer_powered = "Hicom System"
    ws.copyright = "Hicom System"
    ws.app_logo = "/files/App Logo.png"
    ws.favicon = "/files/App Logo.png"
    ws.splash_image = "/files/Splash Image.png"
    ws.banner_image = "/files/Splash Image.png"

    # Redirect logic
    found = any(r.source == "/apps" for r in ws.route_redirects)
    if not found:
        ws.append("route_redirects", {"source": "/apps", "target": "/app/home"})
    else:
        for r in ws.route_redirects:
            if r.source == "/apps":
                r.target = "/app/home"

    ws.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.log_error("Website Settings updated successfully", "Setup Script Success")
except Exception:
    frappe.log_error(frappe.get_traceback(), "Website Settings Update Failed")

Setup Role
SO Batch - Create Sales Orders
script:
# Get defaults company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company") selling_price_list = frappe.db.get_single_value("Selling Settings", "selling_price_list") or "Standard Selling" def resolve_item(part_no, set_or_pcs): """ part_no is the custom_part_no value on the Item master. 1. Find Item by custom_part_no → get item_code 2. For Pcs: return item_code directly 3. For Set: find which Product Bundle contains that item_code → return bundle new_item_code """ item_code = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"custom_part_no": part_no, "disabled": 0}, "name") if not item_code: frappe.throw(f"No item found with Part No: {part_no}") if set_or_pcs == "Set": bundle_parent = frappe.db.get_value("Product Bundle Item", {"item_code": item_code}, "parent") if not bundle_parent: frappe.throw(f"No Product Bundle found containing item {item_code} (Part No: {part_no})") bundle_item_code = frappe.db.get_value("Product Bundle", bundle_parent, "new_item_code") if not bundle_item_code: frappe.throw(f"Could not resolve bundle item code for bundle: {bundle_parent}") return bundle_item_code else: return item_code if not doc.so_batch_items: frappe.throw("SO Batch Items table is empty") # Resolve all items first — fail early before creating anything resolved_items = [] for row in doc.so_batch_items: item_code = resolve_item(row.part_no, row.set_or_pcs) resolved_items.append({ "po_no": row.po_no, "po_date": row.po_date, "item_code": item_code, "qty": row.qty, "rate": row.rate or 0, "remark": row.remark or "" }) # Group by PO No po_groups = {} for item in resolved_items: po_groups.setdefault(item["po_no"], []).append(item) # Create one Draft Sales Order per PO created_sos = [] for po_no, items in po_groups.items(): so = frappe.new_doc("Sales Order") so.company = company so.customer = doc.customer so.order_type = "Sales" so.transaction_date = doc.transaction_date so.delivery_date = doc.delivery_date so.currency = doc.currency so.conversion_rate = doc.conversion_rate so.selling_price_list = selling_price_list so.payment_terms_template = doc.payment_terms_template so.set_warehouse = doc.default_warehouse so.po_no = po_no for item in items: so.append("items", { "item_code": item["item_code"], "qty": item["qty"], "rate": item["rate"], "delivery_date": doc.delivery_date, "warehouse": doc.default_warehouse, }) try: so.insert(ignore_permissions=True) so.db_set("so_batch", doc.name) created_sos.append(so.name) except Exception as e: frappe.throw(f"Error creating Sales Order for PO {po_no}: {str(e)}") doc.db_set("created_sales_orders", ", ".join(created_sos) if created_sos else "") # Show result popup if created_sos: lines = [f"{len(created_sos)} Sales Order(s) created:"] for name in created_sos: lines.append(f"• {name}") frappe.msgprint("
".join(lines), title="SO Batch Complete", indicator="green") else: frappe.msgprint("No Sales Orders were created.", title="SO Batch", indicator="orange")
